post.summary: Create the drafts a slug is missing: tg_ru, plus x_en and li_en once an EN twin is live. Per channel: a channel with a live draft or a sent post is left alone, and without `channels` one that was skipped (or whose send failed) for the same text is not brought back. 202 with the created channels, 200 with [] when nothing was missing. 403 social_disabled, 503 social_not_configured, 409 article_not_published, 404 article_not_found. Drafts are generated asynchronously: list them to see them become pending
